programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: A.I.는 거장 스탠리 큐브릭 감독이 평생의 숙원으로 삼았던 영화였다. 본래 진짜 로봇을 주인공으로 삼으려던 큐브릭의 목표는 실현되기 어려웠고, 큐브릭은 시나리오와 콘티를 거의 완성해 둔 채로 세상을 떠나고 말았다. 큐브릭의 뜻을 이어받은 것은 스티븐 스필버그 감독이었고, 그는 큐브릭에 대한 경의로 그가 완성해 놓은 부분만큼은 그의 본래 구상과 거의 똑같은 모습으로 만든 뒤 미완으로 남았던 부분에 살을 붙였다. 브라이언 올디스의 단편 소설 Supertoys last all summer lomg에서 착안한 이야기라고 한다. 두 거장의 스타일이 어우러지고 또 충돌하기도 하는 데서 두 사람의 연출 스타일을 비교해 보는 재미가 있고, 식스 센스에서 놀라운 연기로 아카데미 남우조연상 후보에 오르기도 했던 할리 조엘 오스먼트의 연기는 이 영화에서도 뛰어나다. 다양한 미래 세계와 편리한 미래 생활들이 등장하긴 하지만 차가운 배경에서 로봇들과 함께 사는 인간들의 건조한 미래 모습이 드러나기도 한다.

programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 회랑정 살인사건
programme.desc: 화염에 휩싸인 그날, 진실과 마주하다. 훙예그룹 회장 가오광이의 살날이 얼마 남지 않았음을 안 가오 씨 집안사람들은 유산과 회사를 차지하기 위해 혈안이 된다. 자신의 유일한 혈육인 혼외 자식에게 유산을 물려주고 싶었던 가오광이는 장위안싱을 시켜 아들을 찾게 하고, 장위안싱은 청청을 찾아낸다. 장위안싱이 청청을 데려오기 위해 설득하는 사이 둘의 사랑은 깊어지고, 가오 씨 집안사람들은 새로운 상속자의 등장에 불편한 기색을 드러낸다. 어둠이 드리운 회랑정 호텔의 밤, 갑작스러운 화재가 발생해 장위안싱은 크게 다치고 청청은 생명의 위협을 받게 되는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 전세계적으로 큰 화제를 모은 반지 원정대 두 번째 이야기. 뿔뿔이 흩어진 반지원정대의 험난한 모험과 중간계 전쟁의 암울한 서막. 판타지 소설의 고전이라 불리는 J.R.R.톨킨의 소설을 원작으로 하는 반지의 제왕 - 두 개의 탑은 절대 반지를 둘러싼 험난한 모험을 다룬 lt반지의 제왕gt 시리즈 그 두 번째 영화로, 전세계적으로 큰 인기를 얻으며 2003년 아카데미 특수효과상과 음향효과상을 수상한 작품이다.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 아주 평범한 동네, 진달래 마을에 사는 엄청 평범한 초등학교 5학년 민호는 어느 여름 날 기묘하고 하얀 생물인 위스퍼와 만나게 된다. 민호를 따라다니던 위스퍼는 신기한 시계 요괴워치를 민호에게 건네고.. 그날부터 마을 곳곳에 나타나는 요괴들이 보이기 시작한다! 일상 생활에서 벌어지는 곤란한 사건의 모든 것은 요괴가 원인이다?! 민호는 사건을 일으키는 요괴들을 설득하고 때때로는 싸우며 사건을 해결한다. 그리고 요괴들과 친구가 된다! 오늘은 또 어떤 새로운 요괴를 만나게 될까?

programme.title: 디스이즈 현무로드 3부
programme.desc: 역시나 정해진 길은 없다. 그래서 시작되는 여행 lt디스이즈 현무로드gt 가고 싶은 곳도, 먹고 싶은 것도 그날그날 마음 가는 대로 정한다. 완벽하게 짜인 여행 대신 두 사람이 직접 선택하며 완성해 가는 낭만 가득한 방랑 로드 트립 프로그램

programme.title: 100일의 거짓말

programme.title: 바로 보는 본방냉장고를 부탁해 since 2014
programme.desc: 최고의 셰프들이 스타들의 냉장고 속 재료를 활용해 요리 대결을 펼치는 요리 토크쇼

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 경세제민 촉
programme.desc: 경세제민 quot촉quot은 국내외 최고의 경제 전문가, CEO, 석학 등을 모시고 일반 시청자의 눈높이에 맞추어 알기 쉽고 재미있게, 또한 깊이 있는 분석과 다양한 해법을 제시하고자 합니다.

programme.title: 배틀로얄
programme.desc: 충격적인 설정과 소재, 그리고 유혈낭자한 살인 장면으로 인해 일본열도는 배틀로얄에 대한 격렬한 찬반 논쟁으로 후끈 달아 올랐다. 배틀로얄은 엄청난 관객을 동원하며 배틀로얄 신드롬을 불러 일으켰다.

programme.title: 少林寺傳奇之東歸英雄
programme.desc: 完成西行任務的少林寺和尚又受康熙委派，護送歸順的萬壽山將軍和冰玉公主東歸京城但是，西魯天會內部反對和談的少數派，認為萬壽山投降清朝，是反清陣營的恥辱太子因為害怕和尚進京使他獨佔明朝寶藏的行為被揭穿，也想方設法滅掉和尚兩方派出各路江湖高手，沿途交叉設關，攔截和尚們與萬壽山，要將他們消滅和尚們面對層層困難，打敗各路高手，甚至犧牲生命，保護萬壽山覲見康熙皇帝和尚們的正義和善心以及天下太平百姓安康的思想感化了對手，也唱響了一首正氣之歌

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.title: 雍正王朝
programme.desc: 康熙皇帝駕崩，繼位者四阿哥胤禛，在當政後出現的攤丁入畝火耗歸公士紳一體當差一體納糧河南罷考案鐵帽子親王大殿發難逼宮含淚殺親子等一系列旨在推行新政抑制官紳斂財和宮廷內部黨爭擠壓的歷史事件貫穿雍正的一生和雍正王朝

programme.title: 台灣傳奇新
programme.desc: 俗話說：歹路不可走歹事不能做毒品不可食為什麼有人敢逆天逆地，犯下滔天大罪？枉死的冤魂 ，誰能替他們討回公道？三百年前的神祕事件，從台灣頭到台灣尾的精彩故事，盡在台灣傳奇

programme.title: Talk一杯
programme.desc: 深度訪談暢飲暢聊！ 主持人鄭偉柏帶您了解最新的娛樂大小事，職業運動文化娛樂多元優質內容一次滿

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: 子豪與馬克是國際偽鈔集團重要人物，情如手足在一次偽鈔交易中，子豪被手下譚成出賣，喪父入獄馬克為報仇卻中槍變成跛子，從此在幫會地位一落千丈；身為警察的弟弟子杰更從此對黑幫恨之入骨子豪出獄後決意退隱，卻遭幫會新貴阿成趕盡殺絕槍戰中馬克身亡，子豪擊斃阿成後轉向子杰自首認罪，重拾兄弟之情

programme.title: 英雄本色II
programme.desc: 香港警方懷疑子豪的恩師龍四操縱偽鈔集團，遂派子杰臥底偵查集團犯罪證據，子豪亦假釋出獄協助警方調查但真正幕後推手實為龍四手下高英培，龍四被迫逃亡紐約，在馬克的孿生弟弟Ken的幫助和保護下，共同返港與子豪及子杰兄弟會合後展開復仇

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 北韓南派組織的3名間諜，爲了完成任務分別僞裝成智障搖滾青年和高中生潛伏於南韓鄉下，發生一連串既搞笑又驚險刺激的諜戰故事長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他們逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳I：雷老虎
programme.desc: 香港警界中，提起雷洛（劉德華飾）這個名字，真是膾炙人口，黑白兩道人稱的洛哥，充滿著傳奇性雷洛剛從警校畢業時，為人正直，不恥於收受黑錢，後來因女友阿霞的父親要求雷洛以五萬元作聘金，雷洛開始了他的受賄生涯

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中，遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，實則要讓王子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難，成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時刻

programme.title: 金錢帝國：追虎擒龍
programme.desc: 1973年，香港警察與黑道勾結，貪污巨利，荼毒市民港督終於決定成立廉政公署，由黑白雙煞陳克和白松安組成第一批廉政公署調查員，調查權傾黑白兩道的總華探長徐樂及黑道霸主跛豪，嚴厲打擊香港的地下規則和貪污的大老虎，兩人聯手出擊，出現了打貪成效，但也因徐樂與跛豪決定合作對抗廉政公署，更有不少廉署成員相繼遇害，但陳克不放棄信念，一場正義與邪惡的爭鬥，從此拉開了帷幕

programme.title: 步步驚心7-9首
programme.desc: 步步驚心7-9首

programme.title: 熊貓計劃
programme.desc: 功夫巨星成龍收養了融化人心的熊貓寶寶呼呼，然而呼呼的可愛魅力讓國際犯罪組織首領祭出一億美金，只為了將呼呼搶為己有！新手奶爸成龍只得和金牌經紀人及熊貓保育員聯手，三個臭皮匠決心一起守護呼呼沒想到這場史無前例的救援行動卻有出乎意料的發展，一場為了超可愛寶貝奮戰的驚險冒險就此展開！

programme.title: 送院途中首
programme.desc: 救護隊員馬志業堅持救人至上，時常不按規定行事；而跟著上司石Sir調職過來的王維，視晉升為工作的最大目標兩人理念背道而馳，在合作時互相產生許多矛盾然而屯門公路發生了嚴重事故，王維發現石Sir不顧傷患，一心只想搶到主導指揮權，轉而跟隨後到現場的馬志業指揮，二人齊心拯救傷者

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: 老丁曾是個功力深厚的軍人，退休後某日帶外孫女到公園玩時，竟讓外孫女走失，家人難以釋懷也不再往來自責的老丁失智症狀更為嚴重，獨自在東北邊境生活，鄰居李政久的女兒小春花勾起老丁對外孫女的記憶，一老一小成了忘年之交但李政久卻捲入中俄黑幫大仇殺，小春花被綁架，老丁決定挺身而出，尋回軍人的驕傲及彌補身為爺爺的過錯，他能否以一人之力擊退黑幫，救回小春花呢？

programme.title: 化劫
programme.desc: 因孩子夭折而精神崩潰的舒雅為了化劫，誤信謠言求助卐應宮，並貢獻自己的八字給藏真法師，心智遭到操控而呈現中邪狀態，肉身被困在神壇上供奉為觀世音菩薩顯靈丈夫友志為了救回妻子，不惜設計空手道社團的無辜學生成為陰廟貢品，一場精心安排的法會結束後，意外讓卐應宮找到更適合魔神降身的肉身容器王羽凡

programme.title: 大贏家
programme.desc: 擅長偽裝和易容術的黃大千，多年來馳騁各大賭場四處騙錢，眾多受害者被黃大千騙得傾家蕩產尋死覓活一群受害者為了討回公道，想盡所有辦法與黃大千爭鬥

programme.title: 開心鬼放暑假
programme.desc: 開心鬼朱錦春轉世投胎為人，取名為康森貴，因前生積善德，天賦超能力，在一女子中任教，班中頑皮女生戴卓儀MAY及姚瓊成立卑鄙會，專門捉弄人，康森貴愛心培育英才卻被女生作弄，引致校長誤會而將他辭退

programme.title: 唐門之神犼雙雄
programme.desc: 唐門門主過世，二十年前的事再次掀起江湖紛爭，各方勢力針鋒相對，中原質子唐離與唐門少主唐天行，少女唐心陷入風暴的中心，一場圍繞兩個少年身世的秘密逐漸浮現，在各大門派的追殺中，二十年的武林大戰再次發生

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳II：父子情仇
programme.desc: 五億探長雷洛傳續集，得到岳父之助東山再起的雷洛（劉德華飾）），在警界鬥爭後升上全港總華探長，坐擁大權香港展開反貪污大行動，雷洛卻在此時遇上了失散的舊情人與擔任廉政專員的兒子（郭富城飾），展開一場父子鬥爭

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅（成龍飾），如今窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔相依為命，在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助於多年未見的女兒小寶與其律師男友乃華與此同時，有人上傳了老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片，精彩的武打動作在網路瘋傳，老羅更獲得拍電影的機會，女兒小寶還幫忙當起了製作人，試圖為老羅與赤兔爭取最好的動作舞台

programme.title: 通天神探狄仁傑
programme.desc: 武則天登基前正在興建高達百米的通天浮屠，此時發生接二連三的駭人自焚案，且死者皆為朝廷權貴武后聽從國師指示，召回神探狄仁傑查案，命為欽差，並派上官靜兒裴東協助兼監視狄仁傑狄仁傑聽從舊日同僚沙陀建議，深入鬼市探查線索卻反遭追殺，隨著案情逐漸明朗，所有證據竟都直指武后本人

programme.title: S風暴
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席調查主任陸志廉接獲線報，香港賽馬會有人與外圍賭盤勾結，在他深入調查後發生多起連環兇案，此時香港警方重案組劉保強卻強行介入調查，在這之中與調查貪污的陸志廉多有摩擦然而在追查案件時，殺手犯案手法日漸兇狠，牽涉的貪污層級也越來越高，兩人不得不聯手合作，從中找尋真相

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: 澳門警司樂一言與妻女一家三口過著幸福的日子，但獨生女樂嘉琪竟慘遭殺害，棄屍郊外，且兇手是以極度殘暴的手法行兇，警方依證據逮捕了她的同班同學邱俊文，就在犯人被判入獄後，樂一言離開了警界，但此時，又再度出現了少女被殺害的命案，讓樂一言開始懷疑，真凶似乎仍逍遙法外，而凶手似乎就是亡命之徒宋境南，讓樂一言決定要查出真相，手刃真正的犯人

programme.title: 地球戰疫
programme.desc: 一場全球性大流行的致命傳染病導致地球上90的人口死亡之後，現在世界上僅有年輕人和免疫者倖存艾莉和奎因在末日後的世界中掙扎求生，但又同時被無情地追捕著，他們的旅程處處都是危險

programme.title: 鬼船瑪麗號
programme.desc: 努力為生活奮鬥的父親（蓋瑞歐德曼飾演），滿懷希望地準備展開租船事業他在拍賣會上購得一艘名為瑪麗號的古船，並興高采烈地帶著妻子（艾蜜莉莫提梅飾演）和兩個女兒出海遊玩乍看歡樂的家庭旅遊，卻因為一連串不可預知的死亡事件，成為一場揮之不去的夢魘究竟，在這片與世隔絕的茫茫大海當中，他該如何保護家人？而瑪麗號又隱藏哪些駭人的詛咒之謎呢？

programme.title: 雷霆殺陣
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 311：東京大震盪
programme.desc: 2011年3月11日，日本遭遇史上最大地震的襲擊，引發福島海嘯災難亞歷珊卓拉剛從法國來到東京，正準備在當地法商銀行工作，卻突然遭逢這場核災危機在工作與家庭間拉扯，逐漸浮現的恐懼與焦慮就要吞噬亞歷珊卓拉離開或者留下，丈夫兒女與仰賴她的員工，亞歷珊卓拉該如何抉擇？

programme.title: 催眠狙擊
programme.desc: 剛復職的警探丹尼洛克在調查一宗銀行搶案的過程中，發現一名具有強大催眠能力的危險男子，竟和自己日前離奇失蹤的女兒有關在催眠師黛安娜協助下，他嘗試追查並拆解箇中謎團，反而讓他們被該男子追殺而身陷險境，事情發展出人意料，顛覆他對身邊一切的認知

programme.title: 冰血殺機
programme.desc: 美國鑽石商人盧卡斯前往俄羅斯進行交易卻因故告吹，搭檔也人間蒸發盧卡斯與西伯利亞咖啡館的女店長卡提雅萌生情愫，在危機四伏的鑽石交易市場裡，兩人要如何安然逃離凶險的西伯利亞？

programme.title: 神鬼獵殺
programme.desc: 世界知名富豪溫氏集團創始人尼里歐離奇墜海溺斃，他的死訊導致跨國經濟體系受到衝擊，更引起溫氏集團繼承人的明爭暗鬥沒有親人的尼里歐早在30年前就收養了一個小男孩羅格溫奇，秘密訓練他成為有勇有謀的精英，也是唯一的合法繼承人羅格溫奇在繼承前的第一個難題，就是洗清自己遭人誣陷入獄的冤屈

programme.title: 仙戒奇緣：神秘寶石
programme.desc: 艾雷王子為了救瑞拉，被壞女巫變成了老鼠瑞拉萬分焦急，便和她的夥伴們四處尋找辦法，想恢復艾雷的容貌他們聽說森林女神的生命石可以破除艾雷身上的魔咒，於是一行人便前往尋找寶石只不過，當他們歷經一番波折，終於見到森林女神時，才發現寶石竟然被法力高強的沙漠女王偷走了！瑞拉和她的夥伴們究竟有沒有辦法奪回寶石，恢復艾雷的容貌呢？

programme.title: 瞞天機密
programme.desc: 在英國情報機構任職的中文翻譯員凱薩琳，某天收到一封讓她備感震驚的電子郵件，內容顯示美國國安局為使聯合國安理會同意發動伊拉克戰爭，竟串通英國政府執行非法行動，企圖改變聯合國表決結果凱薩琳向媒體揭發此事，成功引發世界輿論的關注與譴責在此同時，她也因為違反國家機密法而遭控叛國罪她該如何對抗這個不公不義的政府？而這個世界又將如何回應她的勇氣呢？

programme.title: 火線埋伏
programme.desc: 越戰期間，一群受困在禁區邊緣的美國軍人，手上握有可以改變戰爭命運的高機密文件，卻遭受敵人突襲，讓文件落入對方手中德拉蒙德將軍派出米勒中校改變戰況他率領一群精英突擊隊員，深入敵人隱匿於地下的陣營，他們不僅要一邊找尋那份致命文件，還要一邊躲避越方設下的複雜陷阱，更還要提防難以預料的攻擊

programme.title: 殺手保鑣2
programme.desc: 億萬票房殺手保鑣系列續集，原班人馬霸氣回歸！首集的嗆辣老婆索妮亞保釋出獄後成為受保護的對象，為防止獨裁勢力摧毀整個歐洲，影史最強三賤客合體的嘴賤攻防，前所未見超乎想像！

programme.title: 搶救巴迪
programme.desc: 史帝夫是一名住在威尼斯的私家偵探，每天與他的愛犬巴迪一同辦案，而在某天巴迪突然消失蹤影，追查之下發現是被史蒂夫曾經得罪過的刀幫毒梟蜘蛛綁架了，為了帶回愛犬，史蒂夫必須幫助蜘蛛奪回毒品，開啟了一趟玩命到底甚至全裸帶槍上陣的旅程！

programme.title: 魔女神兵
programme.desc: 十四世紀的法國，貝曼（尼可拉斯凱吉飾）率領一群驍勇善戰的戰士，奉命押解一名被冠以女巫之名的女子上山，交由僧侶作法驅魔經過朝夕相處，戰士們對年輕女子的罪名產生懷疑和困惑，儘管世人堅稱巫女魔力是當時黑死病肆虐的根源，但他們依舊抱有懷疑勇士們遊走於任務與正義之間，友誼也因此受到空前考驗

programme.title: 終極聖徒
programme.desc: 他曾受汙名指控並遭監禁，後來化名為耶穌會士當他發現妻子遭到謀殺兒子被綁架至墨西哥時，他擬定了一個詭譎危險的計劃，試圖營救他的兒子，並為死去的妻子報仇

programme.title: 噤聲終結戰
programme.desc: 天網行動開始，人類與機器的戰爭令大地生靈塗炭，逐漸逼近的機器，為尋找人類倖存者，不僅以視覺檢測來射擊生命體，更透過完美無瑕的傳感器來辨識語音模式，因此，只要開口發聲，死亡即刻降臨

programme.title: 跟著IKEA衣櫥去旅行
programme.desc: 阿賈是來自孟買的街頭魔術師，當他的母親過世後，他決定前往巴黎尋找他未曾謀面的生父阿賈抵達巴黎，卻窮到只能躲進IKEA的衣櫥中過夜，沒想到竟連人帶衣櫥被送往了英國，還被警方當成非法移民遭逢致命的危險，後又輾轉到了義大利羅馬跟女明星奈莉有了難解之緣，阿賈還冒險登上熱氣球飛越地中海沒想到一段超展開的意外旅程幾個萍水相逢的異國人，最後卻幫助他找到了真正的自己

programme.title: 驚天盜數
programme.desc: 維克多是一名小偷，俄羅斯黑幫成員希望他執行一樁搶案，然而維克多對這群新朋友的銀行搶劫計畫並不放心就在眾人準備下手時，國際刑警組織的特工殺死了黑幫成員並逮捕維克多，而負責搶案的司機毒蟲拉沛多卻在維克多的協助下逃走事實上維克多是名臥底警察，但隨著臥底行動終止而被吊銷職位並面臨調查，在心灰意冷之際，維克多決定沿用黑幫計劃，與拉沛多一起搶劫銀行

programme.title: 殲滅戰1941
programme.desc: 改編自二戰哈薩克名人阿迪沙里波夫的真實故事阿迪沙里波夫中尉與他的軍團在敵軍戰線的包圍下撤退未知的恐懼襲來，他們意識到毫不作為的等待將會比敵人的子彈更加致命

programme.title: 疾凍救援
programme.desc: 在加拿大北部一處偏僻的鑽石礦坑發生重大坍塌意外，一群礦工被埋在坑道內，僅剩30小時的氧氣可以存活一支緊急救難隊靠著巨型卡車橫越300英哩結冰湖面構成冰路，救出被困住的26名礦工但他們真正的威脅卻是過去從未遇過的恐怖危機，原來礦坑企業公司為了隱藏爆炸意外主因被揭發，竟雇用大批殺手阻撓救難隊員行進，一場驚天動地的救難行動在冰天雪地中就此展開！

programme.title: 終極殺陣：最後衝刺
programme.desc: 隨著孩子出生長大家計吃緊，廢材警探艾米里決定接下史上最艱難的任務－－押解國際恐怖份子到南非，不得不求助老拍檔丹尼爾共度難關正當兩人認真商討對策時，小兔崽子們也沒閒著，闖禍本領更勝老爸，蠟燭兩頭燒的兩人，這下不僅要身兼奶爸，還要阻止法國淪為國際笑柄！

programme.title: 玩具當家
programme.desc: 經濟拮据的薩米和老婆艾莉絲生活在老舊社區，為了迎接即將出生的寶寶，薩米在一家高級百貨工作賺取穩定薪水在一個打混摸魚的上班日裡，億萬富翁菲利普艾蒂安的獨生子亞歷山大，在隨扈的簇擁下來到薩米的面前，命令薩米當他的生日玩具？薩米雖莫名其妙卻無法拒絕高薪的誘惑然而隨著薩米越來越深入富豪的生活，他發現了一些不可告人的祕密，也迎來天翻地覆的變化

programme.title: 露西亞的願望：搶救聖誕節
programme.desc: 露西亞是第一個就讀聖誕學院聖誕老人班的女孩她最好的朋友被指控偷了冬季國王的魔法水晶，露西亞決心與奧斯卡一起逃亡，並找到真正的小偷，來證明他的清白

programme.title: 黑豹救援軍
programme.desc: 二戰期間，喬治巴頓將軍帶領著他的第三支美軍一路越過法國邊境，殺進納粹德國希特勒為了攔阻敵軍前進，出動了秘密武器Me262戰鬥機一場空中大戰隨即展開弗蘭克羅斯中尉駕駛著這場空戰的其中一架美軍戰機，眼看已敵不過納粹的猛烈襲擊，只好迫降在敵軍陣地內，在等待援兵的同時，非裔駕駛坦克前來營救為了贏得這場戰爭，他們必須將種族差異擱置一邊

programme.title: 玩命快遞：肆意橫行
programme.desc: 法蘭克馬丁卸下特務身分後，轉行成為地表最強送貨員，他的客戶通常是身分可疑的危險人物，不過他從不過問交易細節拿錢辦事而且絕對使命必達當退休的特工老爸來到南法找他時，原以為可以再續父子天倫之樂，沒想到老爸卻涉入蛇蠍美女安娜與其美麗同夥策劃的銀行搶案，法蘭克必須用他非凡身手與飛車絕技，救回最珍貴的家人！

programme.title: 詹姆士龐德007之皇家夜總會
programme.desc: 英美蘇法四大情報巨頭齊聚一堂，一同前往已退休007詹姆士龐德爵士隱居的別墅，請他重出江湖對付神秘的犯罪組織SMERSH為讓龐德無所退路，M秘密下令將別墅炸毀，自己卻被流彈波及而身亡，龐德只得硬著頭皮接下軍情處主管之職為了混淆SMERSH，遂將所有執行不同任務的特務代號都稱為007詹姆士龐德，一群形形色色的間諜便在皇家夜總會展開一場天馬行空大亂鬥！

programme.title: 茱蒂
programme.desc: 茱蒂拍攝完綠野仙蹤30年後，此時的她已經成為兩個孩子的媽，卻因為身陷債務危機，同時還要與前夫為兒女的撫養權打官司她選擇在1968年冬天抵達倫敦，展開為期五週一票難求的演唱會，證明自己還有能力賺錢養活兩個小孩不過在準備演出的同時，她不斷被過去的演藝生涯與私生活痛苦折磨

programme.title: 五湖四海
programme.desc: 擦鞋童小董因緣際會被青幫范大爺收為義子，與小范情同手足，但小董自告奮勇槍殺范家對頭人而入獄十多年，小范卻變成心狠手辣的一方之霸，還娶了小董的女友為妻兩人最後反目成仇決一死戰

programme.title: 八道樓子
programme.desc: 抗戰期間，日軍以大軍夾擊長城要塞八道樓子國軍奉命撤退，僅留吳超徵營長與五位上等兵江明坤褚天成白長興賈福勝以及潘炳林，還有二等兵何鴻發等七名勇士死守據點七人憑藉頑強意志與高超武藝與日軍激戰，最終在彈盡糧絕之下，全數壯烈犧牲攻入樓內的日軍亦深受震撼，肅然起敬立碑致敬

programme.title: 聯合縮小軍
programme.desc: 冷戰時期蘇聯科學家班尼斯投誠美國，途中遭到蘇聯間諜暗殺而命在旦夕於是美國軍方啟動聯合縮小軍實驗室，將網羅各方高手的五人醫療小組放入先進核潛艇中縮小，然後注射入班尼斯動脈，進入大腦以微型雷射槍消除腦部的凝血塊但這項縮小技術只能維持60分鐘，時間一到便會恢復原狀，這批聯合縮小軍要如何在有限時間內達成任務呢？

programme.title: 你在我心上
programme.desc: 在學校裡說方言會被罰款的80年代，蔡志常（張庭瑚飾）和邱素芬（袁子芸飾）是高中同班同學，針鋒相對的兩人，從互看不順眼開始認識彼此，蔡志常發現自己喜歡上邱素芬，欲言又止的暗戀曖昧持續發展著直到高中畢業，蔡志常考上國立大學，邱素芬落榜重考，命運帶領他們走往不同方向，兩人不斷地相遇又錯過，留下擦身而過的遺憾純愛小說教主蔡智恆半自傳故事，公開最讓人揪心卻難以忘懷的初戀

programme.title: 戰略大作戰
programme.desc: 二戰盟軍在法國南部遭遇德軍頑強抵抗，美軍偵察前鋒部隊擄獲一名德軍情報局上校為長官背黑鍋而被拔除中尉官階的士兵凱利，灌醉上校後套出德軍藏匿大筆金條要後送柏林，於是開始招兵買馬說服隊上弟兄長官，準備利用即將到來的三天假期，進行一場神不知鬼不覺的敵後奪寶大作戰！

programme.title: 破壞之王
programme.desc: 外賣小伙計何金銀，因暗戀校花阿麗，決心改掉懦弱性格，拜雜貨店老闆魔鬼筋肉人習武一次何金銀扮成蒙面人拯救阿麗，卻被空手道大師兄斷水流搶去功勞，何金銀心有不甘，遂約戰擂台比武，並揭露大師兄冒名奪愛的真相大師兄老羞成怒，矢誓要在擂台上將何金銀擊斃，何金銀最終則以絕技無敵風火輪應戰

programme.title: 聖保羅炮艇
programme.desc: 1926年的中國，時值軍閥割據與國共內鬥，一艘名為聖保羅的美國炮艇航行於長江流域，其任務是保護在中國動亂地區的美國人民，因而見證了大時代下的中國人民生活本片拍攝於東西方冷戰時期，因政治因素而多於臺灣北部取景，留下不少彌足珍貴的影像

programme.title: 少林寺
programme.desc: 清朝初年禁武，少林寺預感將有大劫，遂廣收方世玉胡德帝蔡德忠等俗家弟子，因材施教傳授絕學，培養反清復明種子眾弟子學成下山復仇後，清兵在叛徒馬福儀引路下包圍少林弟子們聞訊趕回誓死護寺，與清兵展開慘烈決戰最終少林寺被一把大火付之炬盡，但倖存弟子殺出重圍，將少林武學與反清火種傳播至世間

programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 清廷處心積慮消滅少林子弟，特調遣各路高手，火燒少林寺倖存的五位俗家弟子蔡德忠胡德帝馬超興方大洪與李式開逃出生天，誓言反清復仇五人初期武藝不敵清廷鷹犬與叛徒，遂隱匿於少林廢墟苦練絕技學成後，五人分頭決戰仇敵，歷經慘烈纏鬥，終於剷除叛徒與清廷高手最終倖存者會合反清志士，將少林精神與反清火種延續世間

programme.title: 南北少林
programme.desc: 清朝奸臣赫索王爺陷害忠良，兩家遺孤被迫分開男嬰被托孤至北少林出家為僧，名為智明；女嬰則隨長輩隱居南少林，名為司馬燕兩人各自苦練武藝，於赫索壽宴上巧合相遇並刺殺未遂後司馬燕不幸被捕，智明與南少林弟子趙威合力營救，南北少林同門最終齊心合力擊殺赫索報得大仇

programme.title: 吊人索
programme.desc: 退休警官杰德庫柏來到西部購買一批牲口準備務農，卻被一群以退役上尉威爾遜為首自稱為民除害的槍手，指控其謀殺及偷竊牛隻，而私下對他處以絞刑庫柏瀕死之際被經過的法警救下，而真實的犯案者也在事後被逮，法官除還庫柏清白外，更力邀庫柏重回警職擔任警長，成為美國西部聯邦法警庫柏決心整治濫用私刑問題為嫌犯爭取公平審判，並將那班原欲吊死他的惡徒一一繩之以法

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 靈犬雪麗
programme.desc: 男孩小恩與爺爺住在阿爾卑斯山上一天，村民認為有隻流浪大白熊犬咬死羊隻，準備驅離牠，純真的小恩深信牠不是兇手，不僅挺身而出保護牠，更幫牠命名雪麗，一人一狗成為最佳拍檔，形影不離直到納粹德軍來到山上，雪麗因為小恩竟咬傷德軍，村民決定殺死牠小恩和雪麗能否逃過一劫，繼續守護彼此呢？

programme.title: 雷瑪根鐵橋
programme.desc: 二戰末期盟軍已攻至德境萊茵河彼岸直指德國心臟地帶，猶作困獸之鬥的希特勒下令炸毀各座跨河大橋，而盟軍也計畫炸橋後可將德軍分隔兩岸削弱其兵力納粹軍官克魯格少校奉命至雷瑪根擔任萊茵河最後一座鐵橋的守備指揮官，肩負最後一刻執行炸橋的艱鉅任務，然而到任後克魯格發現德軍因敗退而軍令紊亂，正規部隊早已被調往他處，後備部隊只剩不到二百人，更糟的是連炸橋用的炸藥都還遲遲未能送達

programme.title: 破壞之王
programme.desc: 外賣小伙計何金銀，因暗戀校花阿麗，決心改掉懦弱性格，拜雜貨店老闆魔鬼筋肉人習武一次何金銀扮成蒙面人拯救阿麗，卻被空手道大師兄斷水流搶去功勞，何金銀心有不甘，遂約戰擂台比武，並揭露大師兄冒名奪愛的真相大師兄老羞成怒，矢誓要在擂台上將何金銀擊斃，何金銀最終則以絕技無敵風火輪應戰

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮 通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群幽靈助手是他的得力夥伴熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量當喜劇靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 不插電露營
programme.desc: 不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從心出發的旅程山林間的挑戰露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的行動電源，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 沒關係，是愛情啊
programme.desc: 長腿男神趙寅成電視劇女王孔曉振 小說家與精神科醫師的心靈救贖人氣推理小說家張宰烈，表面風光，內心卻深陷思覺失調的困境；精神科醫師池海秀，冷靜理智，卻無法觸碰愛情的傷口在一場火花四射的電視對談後，兩人意外成為室友張宰烈以鋒利的直覺揭開海秀男友的背叛，並逐步探知她拒絕親密接觸的秘密；海秀則用專業的敏銳洞悉宰烈隱藏的內心裂縫當兩個帶著傷痕的人，在彼此的世界中摸索，療癒與愛情悄然交織，他們將走出各自的黑暗，擁抱一段治癒心靈的深情羈絆

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 朴敘俊回歸攜手魷魚2元志安 等待京道譜十年宿命戀十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 老人也有春天！七十歲的我們終於學會說不她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.desc: 老人也有春天！七十歲的我們終於學會說不她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 經典韓劇賢內助女王姊妹作黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: Jeff Buckley: Everybody Here Wants You
programme.desc: Documentary tribute to the singer-songwriter who died in a drowning accident in May 1997, aged 30. Although he had only one album under his belt, he was considered by many to be one of the best singers to emerge in recent years, before his death sealed his status as a doomed romantic hero. Interviews with Brad Pitt, Jimmy Page and Chrissie Hynde highlight how much the gifted musician is missed

programme.title: Talking Pictures: Catherine Deneuve
programme.desc: Celia Imrie narrates a profile of the French actress, featuring archive BBC interviews in which she gives her own take on her fascinating and acclaimed career. She shares stories of working on classic movies including The Umbrellas of Cherbourg, The Hunger, and the controversial Belle de Jour, which saw BBC cameras given unusually open behind-the-scenes access, capturing the tensions that made the film an unhappy experience

programme.title: Belle de Jour
programme.desc: Housewife Severine Serizys traumatic childhood has left her with a sexual desire to be treated cruelly - which her gentle husband is unable to satisfy. Taking refuge in dark erotic fantasies, she eventually finds an outlet for her sexual needs by working in a brothel. Luis Buuels psychological drama, starring Catherine Deneuve, Jean Sorel, Genevieve Page and Michel Piccoli. In French

programme.title: Kirsty Wark Talks to Catherine Deneuve
programme.desc: The renowned Bafta and Academy award-nominated actress talks about her life, career and political activism. Marking the release of her 100th film, relationship story A Christmas Tale, she talks frankly about the movies she has made over the years. First broadcast in 2009

programme.desc: Erics wish for some peace and quiet looks less and less likely as his birthday nears. Beths gift brings embarrassment to the Bairds when an old family photo is dragged out of the loft, exposing the birthday boy in all his glory. Cathy and Colin pop in to say farewell ahead of their sailing trip, while Christine and Sophie turn up in their best mourning clothes after being at a funeral, full of chat about the buffet on offer. Suburban sitcom, starring Alex Norton, Arabella Weir, Doon Mackichan, Jonathan Watson, Elaine C Smith and Sharon Rooney

programme.title: Make It to Munich
programme.desc: Ethan Walker, a promising teenage footballer from Aberdeenshire, was just months into a football scholarship at a US university when he suffered life-threatening injuries in a road traffic accident. This documentary follows Ethan as he undertakes a charity cycle ride from Glasgow to Munich for Scotlands opening Euro 2024 match against Germany just nine months after his accident. Entrusted by the national team to carry the match pennant on his back for the whole journey and deliver it in time for kick-off, Ethan is accompanied by pioneering Scottish surgeon Gordon Mackay, Tartan Army foot-soldier Stephen Collie and film-maker Martyn Robertson

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney and the mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn and officers are on the hunt for a suspect after a woman is attacked in an Inverness cemetery

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: Part one of two. A family home in an affluent suburb of Glasgow is deliberately set on fire and 23-year-old university student Cameron Logan dies as a result of the blaze. Detectives race to determine who targeted the property and why, with the team beginning to meticulously piece together the evidence from the scene and build a picture of the events of that night. With no obvious motive, detectives must follow every lead as they try to understand what really happened inside this family home

programme.title: Songs of Modern Scotland: Celtic Connections
programme.desc: Now in its 12th year, Roddy Harts ever-popular festival staple Roaming Roots Revue returns with a concert celebrating the Great Scottish Songbook. Eddie Reader, Biffy Clyros Simon Neil and Del Amitris Justin Currie are among those revisiting and reinventing modern classics, accompanied by the Royal Conservatoire Scotland Symphony Orchestra under conductor John Logan.

programme.title: Burnistoun
programme.desc: Paul and Walter have trouble with a customer in their ice-cream van, the police leave their own incriminating marks on a crime scene and a racehorse takes revenge on a punter. Comedy sketch show, written by and starring Robert Florence and Iain Connell

programme.desc: Miami Grand Prix Managing Partner Tom Garfinkel tackles the complexities of putting on the race, and F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali reveals why its key to F1s future growth.

programme.title: Inside Motorsport Valleys High-Tech Future
programme.desc: Williams Team Principal James Vowles and F1 Academy drivers champion Abbi Pulling show how advanced simulation is shaping the future of Formula 1.

programme.title: Super Intelligence
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. Are we on a path to superintelligence? Self destruction? Or is the potential promise and threat of AI being overblown?

programme.title: Animal Communication
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI are revealing how animals communicate, and may soon allow us to talk to them. What can we learn from wildlife, and should we be talking to the animals at all?

programme.title: Quantum Computing
programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Who will be first to harness this new technological force, and what will they do with it?

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: Water. Our survival depends on water, yet global reserves are rapidly shrinking. Can technology help secure humanitys future water needs?

programme.title: Pain
programme.desc: For some, pain is excruciating and inescapable. But amid the continuing fallout of the opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed to limit and even eliminate pain.

programme.title: Next Billion

programme.title: Robots: The Aliens We Made
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets some of the worlds most advanced, intelligent, robots. Will the creation of a synthetic species with human-like intelligence improve the human experience, or end it?

programme.title: Love in the Age of Machines
programme.desc: Can we have real intimacy with machines? Emily Chang explores the future of such connections and the technologies powering a growing market of relationships-on-demand.

programme.title: Your Brain Is the Next Tech Frontier
programme.desc: From brain implants that allow paralyzed patients to communicate to the wearable devices enhancing our capabilities, brain-computer interfaces could change the way we use our minds forever.

programme.title: How Tech Is Breaking the Rules of Biology
programme.desc: From birth to death, tech is stretching the boundaries of biology. In this episode of Posthuman, we explore the discoveries that could transform reproduction, healthcare and how we die.

programme.title: Sunil Mittal on the Battle for Indias Telecom Market
programme.desc: Francine meets Bharti Enterprises Founder Sunil Mittal to hear how he went from selling bicycle parts to navigating a relentless battle for control of Indias telecom market.

programme.title: WTOs Okonjo-Iweala on Why Globalization Needs a Rethink
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala about fighting corruption, the personal cost of her work - including her mothers abduction - and leading the WTO through unprecedented trade tensions.

programme.title: How Blackstone Changed Private Equity Forever

programme.title: Ray Dalio, Founder of Bridgewater Associates
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua meets Ray Dalio on OceanX in the port of Nice for the UN Ocean Conference. They speak about radical transparency, building and leaving one of the largest hedge funds and whats next.

programme.title: How to Run Your Familys 1.6 Trillion Empire

programme.title: Netflix Part 1

programme.title: Waymos Bet on a Driverless Future
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to San Francisco to meet Tekedra Mawakana, Waymos co-CEO. Chang asks Mawakana how a career overseeing technological pivots.

programme.title: The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang

programme.title: 娃娃夫人

programme.title: 文素臣

programme.title: 阿牛发达记
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠宝，从此富贵这时，周大叔假意叫他签约迎娶一名女子，却原来是个陷阱，为的是要卖掉他的房子最后，可怜的阿牛又回复一贫如洗...

programme.title: 儒侠

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼夜来香和夜爵士前往日本，意图偷去维纳斯的眼泪巨钻二人见面后即坠入爱河，却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌最后谁会得到巨钻？二人的恋情又会否无疾而终？

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后
programme.desc: 两大武林剑客叶孤城与西门吹雪将于紫禁城决斗陆小凤忖度二人素末谋面，又无利益冲突，无须决斗，猜想当中一定事有蹊跷于是，他决定和花满楼前往京城调查清楚，却发现当中隐藏的阴谋...

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒绝贿赂画师，于是一直被画师画丑致未被皇帝看上但皇帝初遇昭君后，惊为天人，即选中她画师被逐后，为报复而设计将昭君与匈奴可汗和亲皇帝因拒绝婚事即引来两国争战，以致王昭君最后为了平息战乱不得不牺牲自己

programme.title: 英雄无泪

programme.title: 没有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黄太太独力抚养儿子Alex成人，与媳妇阿彤一起生活岂料Alex意外逝世，死前道出外遇女友黑仔已怀有身孕结果三名没有老公的女人同住一室...

programme.title: 盘丝洞
programme.desc: 本片为邵氏西游记系列的第三部作品唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中，希望食唐僧肉而得到永生悟空八戒和沙僧因此大闹盘丝洞拯救唐僧

programme.title: 茅山僵尸拳
programme.desc: 以赶尸为业的陈师父与徒弟受托押运九具僵尸，启程上路未料途中两具竟逃脱其中一具实际上并非僵尸，而是为躲避敌人追杀而假扮的江湖豪客更令人意外的是，此人与陈师父同样身怀绝技，二人皆为深不可测的武林高手！

programme.title: 中国超人
programme.desc: 太空科学研究深所获悉有来自冰河时代的人类所化之怪物将会危及地球上的所有人类这批怪物凶悍异常，神通广大，大有霸占整个世界的野心为了对付这批怪物，科学研究所所长刘英德以自己数十年来的研究心得把勇敢的科学研究员雷马制造成万能超人中国超人开始了与怪物的战斗......

programme.title: 大地儿女
programme.desc: 这是一部经典战争钜片，描述抗日战争时人民的生活状况画家俞瑞意外救了由乡下被拐卖来的女子荷花两人互生情愫，不久更结为夫妻过著幸福的日子无奈好景不常，不久日军全面侵入中国，亦正式展开残酷的统治...

programme.title: 邪斗邪
programme.desc: 余腩沉溺赌海，由于欠债累累无力偿还，遂答应债主以其妻肉偿债项事件被其妻识破，并决意离余而去余动轻生念头，可最终自杀未遂余遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答应给余巨额现金，只要余答应帮他娶得美人归...

programme.title: 插翅难飞
programme.desc: 邓彪因为黑货买卖失手，遂逼江湖人物高明供出从中陷害者，高明说出乃黑豹所为后，即被开枪杀死，邓彪因此被判监禁十五年他出狱后即找黑豹报仇，却遇上势力庞大的葛八爷干扰；同时商琳为寻失踪十五年的丈夫，欲找邓彪查问黑豹下落，但两人仅听过黑豹其名，从未见其人，究竟黑豹是谁？

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宫仙女七妹向往凡间生活，某夜偷驾祥云下凡来到香港初到人间的她人生地不熟，险遭不法之徒欺骗，幸得经营负债累累孤儿院的董自立相救面对贪婪富商觊觎院址步步紧逼，七妹屡施法术相助，却屡遭误解为妖魅两人在困境中互相扶持，情愫渐生，共同守护孤儿院的未来

programme.title: 西游记

programme.title: 舞衣
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，与空姐朱黛舞女姚姚同住，三女各有爱情际遇；白眉虽爱钱，却倾情自称从外地来的路俊，两人只好互许后会有期之愿；朱黛曾迷恋已婚飞机师，分手后又爱上赛车手；姚姚的最大心愿是把清白之躯留给丈夫，她本最爱穷工人李吉，李吉却因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，却仍挂念李吉...

programme.title: 来如风

programme.title: 蛇王子

programme.title: 青春恋

programme.title: 武林风云

programme.title: 冰天侠女

programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第17集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第5集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第13集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第15集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第17集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第17集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第14集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第2集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第11集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.title: 魅影神捕Shadow Punisher
programme.desc: Nine girls vanish in a chilling blood-draining case. Suspected merchant Li Si secretly infiltrates the Divine Constabulary, revealing a shocking identity and a personal vendetta tied to a 17-year-old mystery.

programme.title: 魅影神捕Shadow Punisher
programme.desc: Li Si and the Divine Constabulary race to find missing children in Dougu County. A gruesome murder, mysterious puppet threads and a deadly illusion lead them toward a coroner hiding a terrifying secret.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution Season 1
programme.desc: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: Animals at Play Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if theyre to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the parks establishment gave rhinos a lifeline breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Turtle Beach
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: Wild Latin America Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators before its too late.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Season 1
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill Season 1
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Africas Hunters Season 1
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡二人终于要结婚，却遇到佳母施加压力，令二人产生种种摩擦另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙而当阿健的女友 Jessica意外怀孕时，他陷入人生最迷茫而不知应该如何做决定的时候众人最后可否化解他们感情上的冲突？

programme.title: 我老婆系赌圣My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: 一次偶然的机会，阿轮在沙滩救了患上失忆症的盈盈，并招呼她回家中居住盈盈不单美丽性感，还身手了得，帮助阿轮收坏胀，把欺负他的女友打走盈盈心算比计算器还要快，且赌术精湛，麻雀赌波赛马，她无一不精通阿轮深深的爱上了盈盈，向她求婚，可惜在婚礼举行前夕，盈盈突然失踪当阿轮找到她时，原来她已在参加亚洲赌王大赛，对手是无恶不作的赌场大鳄仇曼联，她还有一个未婚夫亨利阿轮呆住了：难道这一趟他又好梦成空？

programme.title: 红豆Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: 张家经营着位于九龙城的中式甜品店，然而母亲突发中风，令一家人陷入剧变女儿为了维持甜品店的生意，不得不放弃成为空姐的梦想，却在过程中与父亲产生冲突他们一家能否齐心协力，克服重重难关？

programme.title: 风林火山Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: 故事发生在被白雪覆盖弥漫超现实氛围的香港，一场爆炸夺去了暗中操控贩毒集团的药业大亨的性命，令整座城市陷入混乱警方束手无策，家族企业濒临崩溃富商的小儿子誓言摧毁这个建立在罪恶之上的商业王国，却同时要面对在逃兄长的阻挠，以及父亲旧部为争夺势力版图而展开的激烈角逐

programme.title: 惊蛰无声Scare Out
programme.desc: 最新战机核心技术惊传泄密，事态迅速升级为国安危机特工小组临危受命，在都市展开猎谍行动，却屡屡受挫随着调查深入，真相扑朔迷离，矛头渐渐指向组织内部两名昔日并肩作战的王牌特工，在猜忌与背叛的阴影中彼此对峙，一场无声却凶险的较量悄然上演

programme.title: 第二十条Article 20
programme.desc: 检察官韩明在工作和家庭中面临重重挑战：他的儿子与同学发生冲突，妻子随之介入，而他在工作上又要处理与合作伙伴的紧张关系除此以外，一宗重要的案件正考验着他对正义的坚持为了追求公平与正义，韩明决定孤注一掷，冒险一切

programme.title: 爆裂点Bursting Point
programme.desc: 毒品调查科总督察李振邦派出警方卧底江铭渗入贩毒集团希望能捣破首脑韩洋一次警方突袭失败后，激起韩洋复仇怒火而在金三角供应毒品原料的膺秀亦被迫要与警方合作，捣破毒犯巢穴一场警匪大战旋即展开！

programme.title: 说笑之人Stand Up Story
programme.desc: 文少从小已察觉父亲华哥的智力比正常人低，母亲更因此离家出走，留下文少照顾父亲一次偶然机会，文少迷上了脱口秀在找寻灵感中，他发现终极的欢笑其实只是苦中作乐，从自己在校时被同学耻笑，到影响全球的世纪疫症，生活之苦也可以是欢笑之源！

programme.title: 无间一战Endless Battle
programme.desc: 故事围绕着一对兄弟弟弟是贩毒集团的头目，哥哥健忠则是缉毒组探员，二人不约而同卷入一场毒枭的地盘斗争中一次，健忠在押送毒贩的过程中无意间发现弟弟隐藏着的真正身份一场无间反转的正邪交锋随即展开

programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 超级冰冰ShowSuper Bing Bing Show
programme.desc: 超级冰冰 Show是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2Listen! Taiwan Sings 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事Hosted by Wonfus frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwans people and heritage.

programme.title: 风味转身Flavor Tailor
programme.desc: 节目走访台湾十三种经历复育传承或亟待被看见的农渔物产，深入产地跟随农渔民走进真实日常，从凌晨采收到彻夜制作，在台风暴雨与严苛环境中，以最贴近土地的视角，记录他们守护风土延续技艺的坚持与韧性Across Taiwan, this series explores 13 revived, preserved, or overlooked agricultural and fishery treasures, following farmers and fishers through long days, wild weather, and hard-earned traditions rooted in the land.

programme.title: 轧戏Love Between Lines
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘漫雪纷飞谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. Their unexpected real-world reunion unveils hidden identities, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. As they navigate a dislocated space-time, they grow together, transforming through love and self-discovery.

programme.title: 魅影神捕Shadow Punisher
programme.desc: Missing children, stolen incense and a sinister forest point to one truth: the victims are all losing their baby teeth. Li Si uses the last child as bait, exposing a horrifying experiment hidden beneath the woods.

programme.title: 魅影神捕Shadow Punisher
programme.desc: Li Si and the constables uncover Wen Nanshengs twisted quest for immortality using kidnapped children. But after defeating him, an even darker truth emerges, the childrens disappearances began years ago.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Season 1
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives Season 1
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill Season 1
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Africas Hunters Season 1
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys Season 1
programme.desc: The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte Ale volcano.

programme.title: Animals at Play Season 1
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweedall following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in s...

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in natures great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: A Bees Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Irfan dan Sara pulang ke kampung untuk rawatan tradisional sambil Irfan cuba mendamaikan Sara dengan Hussin. Airel semakin berang apabila Sara menolak reunion dan terus mengganggunya. Damia pula semakin pulih. Ketika Irfan kembali bekerja seperti biasa, Airel tiba-tiba muncul untuk menegangkan lagi keadaan.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel mencabar Irfan dan menggelarnya dayus kerana menghalang Sara ke reunion. Demi menjaga hati Sara, Irfan akhirnya mengalah. Namun dia terkilan masih belum dikurniakan zuriat. Sementara itu, rahsia lama Hussin mengundang dendam Dato Muiz. Menjelang harijadinya, Sara menerima hadiah mengejut daripada Airel.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Sara meminta Airel berhenti mengganggu hidupnya, namun konflik memuncak apabila Airel muncul di reunion dan Irfan tersalah faham melihat mereka bersama. Walaupun Sara cuba menjelaskan, Irfan dikuasai cemburu dan ego, sehingga mengugut untuk menceraikannya. Mujur Hussin campur tangan sebelum keadaan menjadi lebih buruk.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Akhirnya selesai majlis pernikahan wok di pejabat agama. Sekejap sahaja segalanya berubah. Wok dibawa pulang ke rumah deris dan janji deris akan selalu membawa wok pulang. setelah seminggu bernikah, belum lagi batang hidung mereka kelihatan. Disangkakan malam pertama penuh bahagia, tersiksa dibalik pintu yang begitu asing bagi diri wok.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok disiksa suami sendiri, disiksa batin dan fizikal kerana nafsu binatangnya. Maimun semakin teruk dan akhirnya menghembuskan nafas seorang diri di rumah. Sampai ke bandar, usop sedaya upaya menjejaki Wok. Akhirnya usop dapat bertemu dengan Deris. Wok dapat melepaskan diri, apabila Deris telah lalai kelam kabut keluar rumah tanpa mengunci mangga pintu.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Siti disahkan meninggal dunia. Shariff pula cuba menjauhkan diri daripada Shida kerana sedar yang Shida tidak berguna lagi pada dirinya. Shida semakin murung. Fendi dan Shahira ditangkap atas tuduhan mensabotaj produk AR Holdings. Arissa dan Muhammad telah membuka restoran dan menjadikan nasi lemak berdasarkan resepi Siti sebagai menu utama dan TJ juga mengikut jejak ayahnya.

programme.title: Secret Book Club
programme.desc: Hari pertama Cikgu Shasha di SMK Bestari Emas dicemari pertembungan prinsip dengan Ustazah Harissa mengenai sistem disiplin sekolah. Dalam diam, Shasha menjejaki anak kandungnya, manakala rahsia Hidayah mula terbongkar. Di tempat lain, satu insiden di butik pengantin hampir merubah takdir Ari dan Putri.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Selepas disahkan positif HIV, Ryan dan Nita berusaha memastikan kandungan selamat manakala Nita membantu memulihkan jiwa Ryan yang tertekan. Sementara itu, rahsia hubungan e-mel Izz dan Dara terbongkar semasa kejutan hari jadi. Walau terpaksa menempuh kemalangan, Izz pulih dan mereka hidup bahagia menanti kelahiran anak baharu.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Pada zahirnya, kehidupan Ameena nampak sempurna. Tetapi pendedahan yang tidak dijangka menghancurkan ilusi itu, terutamanya apabila pengkhianatan datang dari orang yang paling dipercayainya

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia gembira apabila Airel akhirnya menunjukkan sedikit tanggungjawab dan bersetuju menunggu keputusan ujian DNA selepas bayi lahir. DS Johari dan Dato Muiz lega melihat perubahan itu. Di kampung, Tokma menyerahkan cincin pusaka kepada Sara sebagai simbol rumah tangganya dengan Irfan. Walaupun saling merindui, Irfan dan Sara masih dibatasi ego. Sementara itu, Ben membongkar rancangan Dato Muiz kepada Hussin. Kemuncaknya, Airel yang marah kerana Sara kehilangan kerja datang menyerang Irfan dan menyalahkannya atas segala yang berlaku.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel terus mengambil peluang untuk mendekati Sara yang tinggal di rumah Tok Mah selepas berselisih faham dengan Irfan, namun Sara tetap setia dan tidak melayannya. Dalam masa yang sama, Dato Muiz ditahan polis atas tuduhan cuba mencederakan Sara. Tok Mah yang semakin uzur berusaha menyatukan semula Irfan dan Sara dengan menasihati kedua-duanya agar saling memaafkan. Sementara itu, Damia selamat melahirkan bayi lelaki, dan Airel akhirnya berdepan hakikat bahawa bayi tersebut adalah anak kandungnya.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Kematian Tokma menyatukan keluarga di kampung, di mana Maisarah berdamai dengan ayahnya, Husein, manakala konflik ego antara Maisarah dan Irfan serta gangguan daripada Airel berjaya diredakan. Di Kuala Lumpur, Airel bertanggungjawab mengahwini Damia selepas ujian DNA mengesahkan anak mereka. Kisah berakhir bahagia apabila Irfan dan Maisarah berbaik semula, memulakan hidup baru, dan kini bahagia membesarkan anak mereka yang berusia dua tahun.

programme.title: Podcast Lagenda
programme.desc: Untuk episod kali ini, Podcast Lagenda membawakan seorang penyanyi Jazz iaitu Fairuz Hussein. Bermula daripada langkah pertama dalam industri, pengalaman jatuh bangun, hingga mencapai tahap kejayaan hari ini. Episod ini turut menyentuh pengalaman peribadi yang membentuk karakter serta prinsip hidup beliau.

Sementara itu, Ariyana gagal melupakan Rizrin dan melarikan diri daripada abang Rizrin.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana akur berkahwin dengan Azz walaupun masih menyayangi Rizrin. Bagi menyelamatkan keadaan, Rizrin mendesak ibunya mencari calon isteri lain. Sementara itu, pinangan Ryan terhadap Dara dibatalkan akibat keburukannya. Akhirnya, keluarga menetapkan perkahwinan antara Rizrin dan Dara, namun Ryan nekad mahu menghalangnya.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana cuba memujuk Izz kembali, tetapi ditolak demi kebahagiaan Azz. Ryan pula mengancam mahu memusnahkan sesiapa sahaja yang mengahwini Dara, malah cuba merogol Manja sebelum dihalang Eunos. Sementara itu, Izz dan Dara bakal dikahwinkan tanpa sedar mereka sebenarnya merupakan rakan karib di media sosial.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn Abdullah menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Pelepas Saka
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Grace
programme.desc: Selepas kehilangan anak yang dikandungnya, Madeline Matheson berkeras untuk membawa bayi itu hingga haid. Selepas penghantaran, kanak-kanak itu secara ajaib kembali hidup dengan selera untuk darah manusia. Madeline berdepan dengan keputusan muktamad seorang ibu.

programme.title: Kiss Of Dragon
programme.desc: Seorang pegawai perisikan yang dikhianati meminta bantuan seorang pelacur untuk membuktikan dia tidak bersalah daripada konspirasi maut sambil membalas budi kepadanya.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. programme.desc: Pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krewkrew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan berada di Jerantut, Pahang. Kisah misteri dan mistik yang ingin diterokai adalah Gua Kota Gelanggi terletak di Taman Warisan berusia 130 tahun. Beliau menemu bual Encik Muhamad Mohd Yunus, Penyelidik Muzium dan Jurulatih Kebudayaan Pahang dan Encik Osman Ahmad seorang peneroka. Gua ini dijadikan temapt pertapaan dan menuntut ilmu batin menyebabkan berlakunya kejadian misteri saperti penampilan lembaga berjubah dan berpakaian orang asli. Pengantara bersama krew dan Encik kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di gua tersebut selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang menakutkan dan sama saperti diceritakan

Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi Johan Asari yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana Aishah Ilias dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.desc: Sally, Lyla, Citra, Jubed dan Randu lima sahabat dari zaman sekolah menengah merancang satu pertemuan semula. Sally mengajak rakan-rakannya melawat sebuah pulau berhampiran Belitong.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP1
programme.desc: Aafiyah dan Rizq anak kepada pasangan Adelia dan Rafeeq. Aafiyah dimasukkan ke hospital, semasa abangnya menzirahi Aafiyah doktor mengesahkan gadis tersebut mengalami trauma dan lupa ingatan. Sebulan sebelum kejadian, Aafiyah menyambut harijadinya di sebuah hotel tempat ibunya bekerja. Disebabkan kesibukan bekerja, kedua-duanya meninggalkan Aafiyah keseorangan. Aafiyah ternampak seorang bertopeng membunuh seorang wanita, dia yang ketakutan cuba melarikan diri tetapi berjaya ditangkap oleh pembunuh tersebut. Aafiyah berjanji tidak akan membuka rahsia tersebut kepada sesiapa. Aafiyah bersama ibunya berjaya menyelamatkan berkereta keluar dari hotel. Namun pembunuh tersebut berjaya menahan mereka dan membunuh ibunya

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP4
programme.desc: Affiyah ditemui cedera parah dan dihantar ke hospital setelah dilanggar dan dipukul oleh Rafeeq. Kejadian yang berlaku disaksikan oleh Razi. Ritz yang baru pulang kerumah cemas menemui mayat bapanya dan mayat Aeera mati dibunuh.Rafeeq menyalahkan Luzman kerana tidak menjalankan tugas dengan betul sehingga menyebabkan Aeera jadi mangsa. Kemudian berlaku pergaduhan apabila Luzman menemui mayat bapanya dibunuh Rafiq.Sepasukan polis sempat menyelamatkan Rafeeq yang tercedera akibat pergaduhan. Luzman ditahan dan Rafiq yang tercedera dimasukkan kehospital. Rafeeq mengambil peluang untuk membunuh Affiyah yang kebetulan sedang terlantar dihospital yang sama. Affiyah tersedar namun ingatannya tidak baik

programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Jeju Island is renowned for its volcanic landscapes and refreshing sea breezes, where the Nature-Style Beauties enjoyed natural hot spring spas and immersed themselves in the festive atmosphere of a traditional wildfire festival they also took speedboats deep into sea caves and off-road vehicles traversing mountains, embarking on an adventurous journey. Moving on to Hualien and Taitung, they discovered hidden gems and exciting activities, including a whale and dolphin hunt at sea wandering through mountain valleys and enjoying wild hot springs. The team also experienced tribal culture, savoring campfire cuisine and strolling through a forest museum to explore the lives of indigenous people.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

Despite being separated and facing distinct life fates, their ultimate goal remains the same: to survive, fight back, and regroup.
